theory_low.main-claim-gap-faster-than-exponential: A perturbative estimate with stated approximations (Sections g to i), not a proof; the authors write that the findings 'suggest' it. An author claim
theory_low.main-claim-wrong-solution-probability-un: A perturbative estimate with stated approximations (Sections g to i), not a proof; the authors write that the findings 'suggest' it. An author claim
theory_low.abstract-aqo-fails-trapped-local-minima: A perturbative estimate with stated approximations (Sections g to i), not a proof; the authors write that the findings 'suggest' it. An author claim
theory_low.min-gap-set-by-offdiagonal-element: Delta_min = |V12| follows from Eq. (1), but 'exponentially small under AL conditions' is argued by analogy, not proved. Value holds two claims; graded by the weaker
theory_low.mapping-to-anderson-model-hypercube: Eq. (3) rewrites H_QC as hopping on the hypercube, but 'describes the well known Anderson model' is an identification by the authors. The on-site energies are the correlated cost function, and the paper elsewhere says only 'similar to' and 'analogous to' Anderson localization. An interpretation, not a proved result
theory_low.claim-anticrossings-high-probability: A statement of what the authors will show; argued with perturbation theory in Sections g and h, not proved
theory_low.claim-gaps-less-than-exponentially-small: A statement of what the authors will show; argued with perturbation theory in Sections h and i, not proved
theory_low.degeneracy-allowed-by-symmetry: An analytic remark in Section g with no proof; relies on the cited non-crossing rule [18]
theory_low.added-clause-creates-anticrossing: An analytic scenario argued in prose (Section g, Fig. 2), not a theorem
theory_low.added-clause-energy-shift-less-than-4: Stated with 'Note that', no proof in the paper
theory_low.splitting-above-4-suffices-for-anticross: A sufficiency remark followed by 'It turns out'; argued by perturbation theory, not proved
theory_low.series-terms-scale-linearly-in-n: 'We can show' but the paper gives only a sketch via the cluster expansion [22]; not a proof
theory_low.coefficients-sum-of-independent-terms: Rests on the cluster expansion of reference [22], cited not proved
theory_low.bits-in-finitely-many-clauses: 'With high probability' is asserted from M/N = alpha with no proof
theory_low.first-order-splitting-vanishes: An argument from the first-order coefficient in prose; the higher-order claim is not proved
theory_low.splitting-scales-as-sqrt-n: Heuristic (zero-mean random terms) with numerical support in Fig. 3; not a proof
theory_low.lambda-star-scales-n-minus-eighth: A derived estimate from the leading term only, with higher orders neglected; not a proof
theory_low.lambda-star-small-neglect-higher-orders: An approximation the authors justify only by the heuristic discussion in Section i
theory_low.matrix-element-nth-order: A perturbation-theory statement (Eq. 8) given without derivation
theory_low.factorials-cancel-bound-v12: A heuristic argument about 'typical' trajectories, stated as an argument, not proved
theory_low.min-gap-n-over-8-log-estimate: An estimate built on the heuristic bound V12 < (A lambda)^n; not a proof
theory_low.final-minimal-gap-estimate-eq9: The estimate Eq. (9) rests on perturbative and heuristic steps (Sections h and i); the authors call it an estimation
theory_low.adiabatic-time-exceeds-exp-n: Follows from the estimated gap (Eq. 9) and the adiabatic condition T ~ 1/Delta^2, both unproved here; not a proved result
theory_low.anderson-limit-order-eta-after-volume: A heuristic discussion relying on Anderson's cited work [19, 23]; not a proof
theory_low.lambda-cr-hypercube-log-n: An estimate by analogy with the finite-dimensional case [24, 25]; the paper writes 'believed' and 'estimated'
theory_low.anticrossing-avoidance-probability-negli: A heuristic argument in the conclusions with no proof
theory_low.conclusion-no-polynomial-time-ec3: The authors word it as 'suggest'; a conclusion from heuristic arguments, with no rigorous proof
theory_low.filtering-raises-low-energy-probability: Informal argument from Eq. (1). It does not say which eigenstates rise or fall (those with f^2 above or below <F^2>), and 'naturally leads to a reduction of the average energy' is not shown. Not a stated and proved theorem
theory_low.ground-state-probability-increases-each-: A one-sentence consequence of Eq. (1), not a labelled result with a proof. The quote drops conditions: it fails if the state is already the ground state, and the filter changes at each step
theory_low.fvqe-gradient-via-parameter-shift: Eq. (6) is derived in Appendix B 1 using the parameter-shift rule of cited references [36, 37] as a step; a proof that uses another paper's result is not this basis
theory_low.fvqe-vqe-gradient-coincide-at-point: A remark made by comparing Eq. (B7) with Eq. (6), with no derivation in the paper; both rest on the cited parameter-shift rule [36, 37]. Not a stated and proved result
theory_low.fvqe-vqe-second-derivatives-differ: 'We can also see' from Eqs. (B6) and (B8); the paper never shows the two expressions differ (no example or argument). The curvature conclusion is an interpretation
theory_low.gradient-norm-zero-at-tau-zero: A one-line remark with no derivation. It uses 'F becomes identity at tau = 0' (stated, not shown for every filter), and the Chebyshev filter only allows positive integer tau. Not a stated and proved result
theory_low.filters-that-can-use-causal-cones: Read off by inspection of Fig. 2 with a brief justification and a cited approximation [23] for the exponential filter; no proof
theory_low.power-filter-sum-of-local-terms: Elementary algebra stated in prose without a derivation, and it needs H to be 2-local, a condition not in the quote. Not a stated and proved result
theory_low.chebyshev-filter-sum-of-local-observable: Stated in prose without a derivation, and it needs H to be 2-local, a condition not in the quote. Not a stated and proved result
theory_low.benchmark-quantities-approx-ratio-and-gr: An informal remark ('implies' with approximate equalities), no proof or example; not a stated and proved result
theory_low.result-probability-at-least-once-formula: textbook, stated not proved (F129): 1 - (1-p)^M for independent shots. Also the paper says the probability is 'above 0.25', so the formula is a lower bound there
theory_low.appendix-b1-parameter-shift-numerator-tw: The step rests on the parameter-shift rule of cited references [36, 37]; a proof that uses another paper's result is not this basis
theory_low.appendix-b2-vqe-parameter-shift-conditio: The VQE gradient (Eq. B7) rests on the parameter-shift rule of cited references [36, 37]; not proved here
theory_low.appendix-b3-qaoa-gradient-circuit-count: The gradient and the count 2p(n+K) rest on the parameter-shift rule [36, 37] applied term by term; not proved here
